title: Iman with Conviction: When Your Young Adult Faces the World Alone
summary: As your young adult stands at the threshold of university and work, they will encounter ideas and pressures that test their iman far from you. Your goal is not to shield them from every question, but to ensure they emerge with iman built on conviction, not mere imitation—knowing *why* they believe and engaging with those who differ with confidence and adab. Inherited iman falters at the first gust of doubt, but iman built on evidence stands firm.
try_this: This week: Ask your son about the idea he hears most often that shakes his certainty, and sit together to seek a solid answer from a trusted scholar, without denial or haste.
reflection_prompts: What idea is troubling your son’s iman these days?
Did he leave the discussion more at ease or more anxious?
